mapper.select: SELECT ut.id, ut.user_id as userId, ut.tunnel_id as tunnelId, t.name as tunnelName, t.flow as tunnelFlow, ut.flow, ut.flow_unlimited as flowUnlimited, ut.in_flow as inFlow, ut.out_flow as outFlow, ut.num, ut.forward_unlimited as forwardUnlimited, ut.flow_reset_time as flowResetTime, ut.exp_time as expTime FROM user_tunnel ut LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON ut.tunnel_id = t.id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ut.id

SELECT f.id, f.name, f.tunnel_id as tunnelId, t.name as tunnelName, t.in_ip as inIp, f.in_port as inPort, f.remote_addr as remoteAddr, f.in_flow as inFlow, f.out_flow as outFlow, f.status, f.created_time as createdTime FROM forward f LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON f.tunnel_id = t.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_time DESC

SELECT t.id, 0 as userId, t.id as tunnelId, t.name as tunnelName, t.flow as tunnelFlow, 99999 as flow, 0 as inFlow, 0 as outFlow, 99999 as num, null as flowResetTime, null as expTime FROM tunnel t WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.id
